Author: kittenhaswares-ui
Name: Seiton Sense
Punchline: PvP pressure, low-MP Focus, DRK macro, warnings, assists, and target clarity.
Description: A local PvP HUD integrating optional set-only low-MP Focus Target and exact DRK Shadowbringer macro helpers, a top-center 3+ enemy alarm with sound/Sprint options, isolation, pressure and CC-protection cues, resource auras, fail-closed assists, team communication and target highlights.
Changelog: Hotfixes the default-off /seitonbringer helper and adds explicitly enabled Wolves' Den striking-dummy testing. The Den path requires the existing DRK and Wolves' Den options and accepts only the unchanged exact native current hard-target combat dummy with NameId 541; it never uses synthetic S1, e-list or duel-opponent resolution, another target, an alternate, or a retry, while the canonical CC path is unchanged. The current combo metadata gate now pins the exact 0/58/58/147/147/147 secondary cost types instead of failing closed on an incorrect all-zero assumption, and initial GCD observation is deferred to the framework update thread. The one-proven-GCD, inclusive 0.60-0.80-second, spend-before-request, Guard, queue, resource, readiness, and native range/line-of-sight contracts remain unchanged. Configuration schema 24 is unchanged and no setting was added; live Den and CC timing remain separate confirmation boundaries.
